product_metadata.title: Windowsandgarden Cordless Cellular Honeycomb Shade, 21 to 24 Wide x 24 to 72 High, Antique Linen Light Filtering
features: PLEASE FOLLOW the easy steps below when ordering. STEP 1: Select your color. STEP 2: Click on the first drop down above the colors and you will see different price grids for that color. For WIDTH pick the price grid that you width falls into. Step 3: hit the yellow "customize now" button to the right. Then you will see every 1/8th of an inch within that price grid. For height round up to the inch.

STEP 4: pick “inside” or “outside” the window frame mount. See directions below for inside and outside mounts. STEP 5: Pick your exact width and height in the customization drop down. For inside mount give us the exact opening to the 1/8th of an inch and we will take a 3/8 inch deduction off the width on our end. For an outside mount give us the exact size you want the shade to come. Typically for an outside mount you go wider then the opening and mount it above the opening. STEP 6: add to cart

For an INSIDE THE WINDOW FRAME MOUNT, fill out the customization form with the exact measurement of the opening to the 1/8th inch and WE will take a 3/8 inch deduction off the exact measurement given so the shade will fit perfectly in that opening. The shade must be slightly smaller than the opening to fit inside. Again, we take the deduction so give us the exact opening to the 1/8th inch. You need at least 1 1/4 inch of depth at the top of the window for an inside mount.

For an OUTSIDE the window frame mount we take no deductions- provide us with the exact size you want the shade to come when filling out the customization form. Outside mounts are traditionally mounted above the window opening and go slightly wider than the opening. These are child safe cordless light filtering cellular shades which are also known as pleated shades or honeycomb shades. They are light-filtering and offer complete privacy. Limited lifetime warranty All Hardware is Included.

These are BOTTOM-UP ONLY shades. If you need our top down bottom up shades, click on our store right above the star ratings. This will allow you to see all of our products. We no longer send customization emails because you can now customize your order when ordering. These cellular shades have a min with of 21" and a max width of 72". Minimum height is 24" and max height of 72". Headrail is 1 5/8" deep and 1" high. Min inside mount depth required is 1 1/4", flush inside mount is 2".
description: THESE ARE BOTTOM UP ONLY SHADES and NOT top down bottom up shades. We do have top down bottom up shades but that is a different product listed on Amazon. You can find all our products if you click on our store on the top of the page near the star ratings. PLEASE REVIEW the 6 easy steps on how to order in the bullet points. We recently had to take down a number of heights per Amazon's new policy. We still have every height available even if you do not see it. Our Light Filtering Cordless Cellular Shades are available in nine of our most popular colors. We can do any size from 21 to 72 wide and 24 to 72 high. We give you the ease and safety of a cordless upgrade reconfiguration and cut them to the nearest 1/8 of an inch, ensuring a perfect fit. These are our most economical cellular shades, but they are still top-rated for quality and durability! Cordless cellular shades are also known as pleated shades or honeycomb shades. These are a single cell shade which means there are two pieces of material that form a single comb. They are 100% polyester and come with a limited lifetime warranty. These are window treatments you will have for many years to come. We can customize these child safe cordless cellular shades up the 1/8th of an inch.

details.Warranty Description: Limited lifetime warranty on the entire product against defects in manufacturing (for example, a flaw in product design, materials, or workmanship that causes the product to cease to function) 5 year warranty on all fabric, 3 year warranty on cords, including internal cords such as those found in our cordless shades.
